slug.description: Unique in the system; it's what appears in the URL.

toolRouterEnabled.description: Whether the tool-routing step by the Jev (ADR 0179) runs for this workspace. On by default; it only acts when the turn model is from OpenRouter, so `true` on a workspace without OpenRouter does nothing.

400.description: Invalid body. The `ValidationPipe` runs with `whitelist` and `forbidNonWhitelisted`, so an unknown field also fails.

401.description: No token, expired token, or invalid signature.

404.description: Workspace doesn't exist or is invisible to the caller.

409.description: `titular_precisa_ser_owner`: the target is not an `owner` of the workspace.

429.description: Rate limit per user or per IP.
